capabilities: publish the active note to Hatena Blog
post a note as a draft
delete the published article of a note
insert a table of contents rendered on the blog
store the API key securely via Obsidian's Keychain
extras: Blog's editing mode must be set to Markdown mode; comments wrapped in %% stay local and are not published; requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later; README also available in Japanese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to post notes to a Hatena Blog, so publishing a note required manual copying into the blog editor.
summary: Publishes notes directly to a Hatena Blog via its AtomPub API, with support for drafts, deletion, and blog-only tables of contents.
